text:
[IRET.14.1] `NOW` expression nodes read the engine's held wall-clock
sample directly, and `monotonic_ns()` nodes its held monotonic sample; neither
calls the clock function, which runs only at a sample point ([LTIM.2.8.4]).
This is not a builtin call (it would be hot path in time-bound rules); it is a
direct field read in the evaluator.

idris.name: iret_25_4_1__fire_reads_held
idris.note: 'Neither calls the clock function': the count of source calls across a firing's encounters is what it was.

idris.name: iret_25_4_1__now_node
idris.note: 'Read the engine's held wall-clock sample directly': a field read, as the clause has it, and not a builtin call.

idris.name: iret_25_4_1__one_value_per_pump
idris.note: 'The clock function runs only at a sample point': across every firing of a pump the count of source calls is unchanged.
